requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall meet the radiated narrowband emission limits throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

requirements.text: The radiated narrowband emission measurements of the rear lamp ESA shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.

requirements.text: The radiated narrowband emission measurements of the rear lamp ESA shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Tables 1 and 2.
requirements.quote: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver. The parameters to be used are defined in Tables 1 and 2.

requirements.text: Where a spectrum analyser is used, the spectrum analyser parameters for the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz with average detector shall be RBW at -3 dB of 100/120 kHz and minimum scan time of 100 ms/MHz (Table 1).
requirements.quote: Table 1 Spectrum analyser parameters Frequency range MHz Average detector RBW at -3 dB Minimum scan time 30 to 1,000 100/120 kHz 100 ms/MHz
atomic: Where a spectrum analyser is used for 30 to 1,000 MHz, the RBW at -3 dB shall be 100/120 kHz.
Where a spectrum analyser is used for 30 to 1,000 MHz, the minimum scan time shall be 100 ms/MHz.

requirements.text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video band width shall be at least three times the resolution band width (RBW).
requirements.quote: Note: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video band width shall be at least three times the resolution band width (RBW)

requirements.text: Where a scanning receiver is used, the scanning receiver parameters for the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz with average detector shall be BW at -6 dB of 120 kHz, maximum step size of 60 kHz and minimum dwell time of 5 ms (Table 2).
requirements.quote: Table 2 Scanning receiver parameters Frequency range MHz Average detector BW at -6 dB Maximum step size Minimum dwell time 30 to 1,000 120 kHz 60 kHz 5 ms
atomic: Where a scanning receiver is used for 30 to 1,000 MHz, the BW at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz.
Where a scanning receiver is used for 30 to 1,000 MHz, the maximum step size shall be 60 kHz.
Where a scanning receiver is used for 30 to 1,000 MHz, the minimum dwell time shall be 5 ms.

requirements.text: The radiated narrowband emission test of the rear lamp ESA shall be performed at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, except that, if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, the frequency range may be divided in 14 frequency bands 30-34, 34-45, 45-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100-130, 130-170, 170-225, 225-300, 300-400, 400-525, 525-700, 700-850 and 850-1,000 MHz and tests performed at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band.
requirements.quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz. Alternatively, if the manufacturer provides measurement to data for the whole frequency band ... the Technical Service may divide the frequency range in 14 frequency bands ...

requirements.text: If the limit is exceeded during the radiated narrowband emission test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the rear lamp ESA and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from the ESA.
requirements.quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from the ESA.

requirements.text: For the radiated narrowband emission test of the rear lamp ESA, the maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
requirements.quote: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall comply with the immunity requirements of any combination of the test methods (a) Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2, (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3, (c) Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4, (d) Stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5, (e) Reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11, provided that these result in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
requirements.quote: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered

requirements.text: The frequency range and general test conditions of the rear lamp ESA immunity tests shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: (Frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1).

requirements.text: The test conditions of the rear lamp ESA during immunity tests shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: The test conditions shall be according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: During immunity tests, the rear lamp ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
atomic: During immunity tests, the rear lamp ESA under test shall be switched on.
During immunity tests, the rear lamp ESA under test shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.

requirements.text: The immunity measurements of the rear lamp ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
atomic: The immunity measurements of the rear lamp ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range.
The immunity measurements of the rear lamp ESA shall use frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation for the rear lamp ESA immunity test shall be: (a) AM, with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range; (b) PM2, Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range; and (c) PM3, Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.quote: The test signal modulation shall be: (a) AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range; (b) PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range; and (c) PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges. If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
atomic: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation for the rear lamp ESA immunity test shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.

If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation for the rear lamp ESA immunity test shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.

If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation for the rear lamp ESA immunity test shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz frequency range.

If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation for the rear lamp ESA immunity test shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency range.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time for the rear lamp ESA immunity test shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
atomic: The frequency step size for the rear lamp ESA immunity test shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
The dwell time for the rear lamp ESA immunity test shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The bulk current injection test of the rear lamp ESA shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with either the BCI substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or the BCI closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA, except that as an alternative the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the BCI substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA;Or BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA. As an alternative the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
atomic: Where the bench BCI test with substitution method is used, the bulk current injection test of the rear lamp ESA shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 with the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.

Where the bench BCI test with closed loop method is used, the bulk current injection test of the rear lamp ESA shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 with the injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.

Where the rear lamp ESA is tested while installed in the vehicle, the bulk current injection test shall be performed according to ISO 11451-4 with the BCI substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall be tested for immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines by applying the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
atomic: The rear lamp ESA shall be tested with test pulse 1 according to ISO 7637-2 applied to the supply lines and to other connections which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
The rear lamp ESA shall be tested with test pulse 2a according to ISO 7637-2 applied to the supply lines and to other connections which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
The rear lamp ESA shall be tested with test pulse 2b according to ISO 7637-2 applied to the supply lines and to other connections which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
The rear lamp ESA shall be tested with test pulse 3a according to ISO 7637-2 applied to the supply lines and to other connections which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
The rear lamp ESA shall be tested with test pulse 3b according to ISO 7637-2 applied to the supply lines and to other connections which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

requirements.text: The rear lamp ESA shall be tested by applying the starting profile according to ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to the starting profile.
requirements.quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines. ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the rear lamp ESA on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
atomic: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the rear lamp ESA shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on the 12/24 V supply lines.

The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the rear lamp ESA shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
